up: Return a list of distinct compounds that have been tested against the human protein TAR DNA-binding protein 43 (TDP-43). For each compound, provide its ChEMBL identifier and preferred name. The target is the single protein Homo sapiens TAR DNA-binding protein 43.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id, md.pref_name FROM activities a JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno WHERE td.pref_name = 'TAR DNA-binding protein 43' AND td.organism = 'Homo sapiens'
